title: Florida Lake Tours
specs: Tours on Butler Chain of Lakes with 12 interconnected lakes and celebrity homes
Wildlife sightings including alligators, pelicans, blue herons, turtles, hawks
Watersports options included: wakeboarding, wakesurf, tubing, waterskiing, fishing
All ages welcome; children under 2 free and must remain on parent's lap

blurb: Guests can enjoy private or group boat tours on the Butler Chain of Lakes, exploring celebrity mansions, wildlife, and natural scenery. Tours include options for watersports like wakeboarding, tubing, and fishing at no extra cost. Boats are captained by licensed experts and customizable for events such as corporate outings, parties, and family gatherings.
extraNote: Book at least 24 hours in advance; 48 hours recommended for rescheduling · No cancellations or refunds; no-shows not refunded · Tours rescheduled if weather is bad; Florida storms usually pass quickly · Tipping not included or required · 10900 Chase Road, Windermere, FL 34786 at RD Keene Park Ramp; park in grass area along fence line at end of park, not near playground.
